messages:
sara_cs: Heads-up — OrchardHealth showing a sudden latent usage signal. Active seats dropped from 18 -> 10 over last 7d, tokens and calls down too. Primary contact moved to Procurement (no heads-up to CSM). @mike_am @jordan_se can we triage and decide next steps? :thinking:

mike_am: On it. Can you drop the quick metrics and any recent change notes? I'll ping GTM if this looks like churn risk. :phone:

sara_cs: metrics snippet:
```
metric,last_7d,prior_7d
api_calls,1.2k,2.1k
active_seats,10,18
avg_tokens_per_call,320,410
```
no incident flags in logs, last deploy 3 days ago. Procurement contact is "Ayesha" per account email.

jordan_se: thx — FYI we saw VendorX spin up a trial on their side last week (from a public footprint). Could be competitive eval + procurement-led POC. Recommend: 1) immediate 15m sync with Ayesha, 2) enable short pilot offer (3mo), 3) playbook: value recap + integration wins.

emily_csm: I can own the Ayesha sync. I'll request 15m intro and bring a VP-level ROI slide. Need a one-pager and a quick list of recent wins to share. @sara_cs can you DM the churny customer notes and any top tickets? :+1:

sara_cs: DM sent. Also capturing recent feedback: slower response on billing questions, and they asked for on-prem options (Procurement flagged compliance).

mike_am: Noted — compliance ask could push them to VendorX if they have on-prem. Let's surface Dedicated/Private options in the call but keep it non-salesy. Offer a short compliance checklist and intro to Solutions Eng.

ops-bot: [automated report] OrchardHealth usage anomaly detected (confidence 0.84). Opened task CS-4872 for follow-up.

jordan_se: I'll prep the ROI bullets and a 3-bullet technical win (latency, cost per token, caching). Send over by EOD.

emily_csm: Scheduling now — aiming for 15:30 PT tomorrow. If they accept, I'll loop in legal briefly to smooth procurement asks.

sara_cs: Thanks team. Goal for the call: understand procurement drivers, surface Dedicated/Private feasibility, and propose a short re-engagement pilot. Will post updates here after the call. :memo:
